# pki.sgit.ai's key library, vendored: keys.js and message.js

Copied unedited on 6 November 2026 by dev.search@PrompTugal.dinis from https://pki.sgit.ai/lib/latest/keys.js and
https://pki.sgit.ai/assets/people/message.js (the site of the repository SGit-AI/SGit-AI__Website__PKI; the exact upstream
commit was not read: the files were fetched from the live site). Used by assets/onboard/ (vault onboarding: the reader's
key pair, the issuer's signature, the signed seal of a claim, the sealed mailbox). message.js imports ./keys.js, so both
sit in this folder. Loaded only by the onboarding module, never on every page.
